en: Hello, the {kind} of {amount} for order {po_id} is due on {due_date}. Please release the goods when it arrives.
Hello, quality problem in order {po_id}: {product}, {rejected_units} units rejected ({defect_type}). Photos follow.
Hello, please send a credit note of {amount} for claim {claim_id} ({units} units, {reason}).
Hello, our order of {product} is {order_qty} units. Can you lower the minimum of {min_units} units for this product?
Hello, please quote {qty} units of {product} with lead time and terms. We need your answer this week.
Hello, we accept your quote {quote_id} for {product} at {price}, valid until {valid_until}. A purchase order follows.
Supplier: we need the goods before
Hello, we need {product} ({qty_open} units, order {po_id}) before {expected_date}. Please confirm that you can ship in time.
Hello, for {product} please pack {pack_size} units in a pack and {carton_units} units in a carton, with our label on every carton.
Hello {contact}, we would like to review our terms: {terms}. Can we talk this week about the deposit and the days to pay?
Hello, we cannot accept a higher price for {label}. Our cost is {unit_cost}. Please send the reasons or keep the price.
Order {po_id} from {supplier} arrives on {expected_date}: {units} units. Please plan the receiving.
Order {po_id} from {supplier} is {open_late} days late. Please check the stock of the products and tell me what to do.
Quality check {check_id}: {product} from {supplier} shows a defect rate of {defect_rate}. Result: {result}.
Reorder list: {product}, {qty} units from {supplier}, value {order_value}. Supplier minimum check: {min_check}.
Owner: payment due to a supplier
Payment due: {kind} of {amount} to {supplier} for order {po_id} on {due_date}.
Scorecard of {supplier}: score {score}, rank {rank}, on-time rate {on_time_rate}. Verdict: {verdict}.
{supplier} delivers on time in only {on_time_rate} of orders, {avg_days_late} days late on average. Should we review the terms?
Please approve purchase order {po_id} to {supplier}: goods {goods}, landed total {landed_total}.
Please pay {amount} ({kind}) to {supplier} for order {po_id} by {due_date}.
Freight and duty for order {po_id}: {amount} (freight {freight_amt}, duty {duty_amt}). Please book the invoice.
Goods for order {po_id} ({units} units) arrive on {expected_date}. Please free the receiving bays.
Please inspect order {po_id} from {supplier} before booking it in. Check a sample of cartons and note the defects.
Hello, please confirm pickup for order {po_id}: {weight_kg} kg, departure {departure}.
{product} arrives late ({expected_date}, {days_to} days from now). Please update the listing and pause ads if stock is out.
Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.
We order {col:pos.units} units with a goods value of {col:pos.goods}. Freight is {col:pos.freight} and duty is {col:pos.duty}, so the landed total is {col:pos.landed_total}.
We pay a deposit of {col:pos.deposit_amt} and a balance of {col:pos.balance_amt}. Please confirm the order, the ship date and your pack and label details by return message.
Please send your best price for this quantity, the lead time and your payment terms. Our lead time wish is {col:quotes.lead_days} days. We ask you to answer within {set:quote_days} days.
Please say how long your price stays valid and the minimum order and pack size that apply. The last price we know is {col:quotes.price}.

The price is {col:compare.price}, which is {col:compare.gap} above the lowest price of {col:compare.best_price}. The lead time is {col:compare.lead_days} days; the shortest offer is {col:compare.best_lead} days.
Quality is {col:compare.quality} and terms are {col:compare.terms} on a scale of 1 to 5. The weighted score is {col:compare.score}, rank {col:compare.rank}: {col:compare.choice}.
Goods received and quality check report
Purchase order {col:qc.po_id}, supplier {col:qc.supplier}, checked on {col:qc.date} by {col:qc.checked_by}.

Product: {col:qc.product}. We received {col:qc.qty_received} units and checked {col:qc.qty_checked}. We found {col:qc.defects_found} defects ({col:qc.defect_type}), a defect rate of {col:qc.defect_rate}.
The limit check shows: {col:qc.limit_state}. We rejected {col:qc.rejected_units} units. The result is {col:qc.result} and the credit we ask for is {col:qc.credit_amount}.
Quality claim letter to a supplier
Reason: {col:claims.reason}. Affected units: {col:claims.units}. We ask for a credit note of {col:claims.amount}.
The claim was raised on {col:claims.claim_date} and is {col:claims.age_days} days old. Its state is: {col:claims.state}. Please answer within {set:claim_days} days.

On-time rate {col:scorecard.on_time_rate}, average days late {col:scorecard.avg_days_late}, defect rate {col:scorecard.defect_rate}, price changes {col:scorecard.price_changes}, rating {col:scorecard.rating}.
Spend is {col:scorecard.spend}, {col:scorecard.share} of all purchases. The score is {col:scorecard.score}, rank {col:scorecard.rank}: {col:scorecard.verdict}.
Payment schedule note for the bookkeeper
Kind: {col:payments.kind}. Amount: {col:payments.amount}. Due on {col:payments.due_date}. Paid on: {col:payments.paid_on}. Status: {col:payments.status}.
Please book the payment against the purchase order and keep the supplier invoice with it.
Late delivery notice to a supplier
The order was expected on {col:pos.expected_date}. Days past the expected date: {col:pos.open_late}. Timing: {col:pos.timing}.
Please tell us the new ship date and the reason for the delay. We may ask for a part shipment by air if the delay grows.
Last contact: {col:contacts.last_contact}, {col:contacts.days_since} days ago. Topic: {col:contacts.topic}. Next review: {col:contacts.next_review}. State: {col:contacts.state}.
Actions agreed: ____________________. Reviews take place every {set:review_days} days.
Landed cost statement of a shipment
Shipment {col:freight.ship_id} for purchase order {col:freight.po_id} from {col:freight.supplier}, by {col:freight.mode}.
Goods {col:freight.goods}, freight {col:freight.freight_amt}, duty {col:freight.duty_amt}: freight and duty {col:freight.amount}, which is {col:freight.fd_rate} of goods.

The supplier terms say {col:freight.expected_rate}. The check shows: {col:freight.state}. The shipment weighs {col:freight.weight_kg} kg on {col:freight.pallets} pallets, {col:freight.per_kg} of freight per kg.

Open Start and type your shop name and your limits in the yellow cells: warning days, late days, highest acceptable defect rate, lowest supplier rating and the weights of the score.
Check Suppliers: lead time, minimum order, days to pay, deposit, freight and duty rates and rating. Orders, spend and the average order fill in.
Keep Products up to date with the ex-works cost and the supplier. Landed cost fills in from the supplier rates.
Enter each purchase order on Purchase Orders and its lines on PO Lines. Landed total, days late, on-time flag and payments fill in.
Each week read Reorder Proposals and Open Orders: what to order and what is late or arriving soon.
Record deposits, balances and freight and duty on Supplier Payments. Overdue and due soon payments are marked.
Record every receiving check on Quality Checks and every claim on Claims and Credits.
Use Quote Comparison and Price Quotes before you accept a price, and Sample Requests before the first order.
Read Supplier Scorecard, Lead Time Log and Freight and Duty before every supplier review; write the contact on Contacts and Visits.
Track Import Documents and the Transit Plan for every shipment by sea, air or road.
Use the 14 calculators for landed cost, order totals, order quantity, minimums, on-time rate, score, quotes, defects, cash, early payment, air or sea, freight rates, safety days and price breaks.
Read Purchasing Dashboard and Charts every week: open orders, late deliveries, payments, quality and supplier scores.

Shipping gap per order and channel
what the carrier charged against what the customer paid, for every parcel, channel and region

days promised to the customer are compared with the days from order to door and late orders are flagged
Carrier rate table by weight and zone
the price of every weight band and zone for each carrier, ranked from cheapest
type weight, zone and the most days you accept to see the cheapest carrier that can do it
Pick and pack minutes against expected
minutes for every order are compared with the time its items should take and slow orders are flagged
today's parcels per carrier with pickup hour and a warning for parcels not packed in time
claim deadlines, carrier compensation and the net cost of each late, lost or damaged parcel
Peak plan with packers and cartons
expected orders in each peak week give the packers needed, the staff gap and the cartons to buy
Wholesale order book with overdue days
terms, due dates and days overdue of every wholesale order next to its delivery status
days of cartons, mailers and tape left at your real order rate and the quantity to reorder
cut-off, handling days and free-shipping limits per channel against the shipping the shop really pays

Orders: every order from payment to delivery
One row for each order with its channel, items, amounts and carrier; the total, the zone, the promised days, the days to ship, the transit days and whether it is on time fill in by themselves.
Order lines: what each order contains and what it earns
One row for each product on an order with quantity and price; the product name, line total, landed cost, margin and margin percent fill in.
Order pipeline: open orders and what each needs next
One row for each open order with its owner and priority; the stage, the age in days, the next action and whether it waits too long fill in.
Pick and pack log: minutes for every order
One row for each order picked and packed with the person and the minutes; items, total minutes, minutes per item, labour cost and a pace check fill in.
Dispatch board: today's parcels by carrier
One row for each parcel leaving today with its carrier, pickup hour and status; the customer, weight and whether the parcel is ready for the pickup fill in.
Carriers: rates and delivery days for every zone
One row for each carrier and zone with delivery days, fees and the carrier's phone; the key, the cost of 1 kg and 5 kg, the orders sent and the real transit days fill in.
Carrier rate table: price by weight band and zone
One row for each carrier, zone and weight band; the price comes from the Carriers sheet and the cost per kilogram, the delivery days and the rank among carriers fill in.
Shipments: parcel cost against what the customer paid
One row for each shipped order with the carrier, weight, shipping cost and shipping charged; the gap, the gap percent, the cost per kilogram and whether the customer covered it fill in.
Delivery times: the promise against what happened
One row for each shipped order with the days promised to the customer; the carrier, the dates, the real days from order to door, the days over and whether it was on time fill in.
Late and lost parcels: claims and compensation
One row for each late, lost or damaged parcel with the claim status and the money involved; the carrier, the claim deadline, the net cost and the next step fill in.
One row for each cancelled order with the reason, who cancelled and the refund; the customer, the order total, the days to cancel and the refund share fill in.
Address and payment problems: found, fixed or given up
One row for each order that stopped for an address or payment problem with the owner and the dates; the customer, phone, days open and a stuck warning fill in.
Wholesale order book: accounts, terms and what is due
One row for each wholesale order with the account terms and the payment dates; the customer, the total, the order status, the days overdue and a payment check fill in.
Channel rules: cut-off, handling time and shipping
One row for each channel and carrier with the cut-off hour, the handling days, the shipping charged and the free-shipping threshold; the orders, the charge actually paid and the gap fill in.
Packaging stock: cartons, mailers, tape and fillers
One row for each packaging item with the stock, the reorder point and the use per order; the stock value, the days left, the quantity to order and a reorder warning fill in.
Daily order summary: orders, units and sales for every day
One row for each of the last 120 days with the orders, units, sales, cancelled and same-day shipped counts; the 7-day average, the average order and the same-day rate fill in.
Fulfilment roster: who packs and for how many hours
One row for each person and week with the hours planned; the packing capacity in orders, the labour cost and an overtime check fill in.
Peak plan: busy weeks, staff and cartons needed
One row for each week with last year's orders and the orders you expect; the growth, the orders a day, the packers needed against the team and the cartons needed fill in.
Regions and zones: sales tax and delivery zone
One row for each delivery region with its demo sales tax rate and its zone (1 near, 2 far, 3 export); check your own rates.
Products: the range, with landed cost and sales
One row for each SKU with its cost, price and weight; the display name, the weight in kilograms, the units sold, the sales and the margin on the sample orders fill in.

Customer: your order is on its way
Hello {customer}, your order {order_id} is on its way with {carrier}. Expect it in about {promised} days. Thank you for shopping with us.
Hello {customer}, your order {order_id} is later than promised. We are chasing the carrier and will send a new date soon. Sorry for the wait.
Hello {customer}, we need to check the delivery address for order {order_id} ({issue}). Please reply with the full address.
Hello {customer}, your order {order_id} was cancelled ({reason}). We refunded {refund}. Sorry for the trouble.
Customer: payment did not go through
Hello {customer}, the payment for order {order_id} did not go through. Please try again or use another method so we can ship it.
Hello {customer}, part of order {order_id} ships separately because one item is not in stock. You pay no extra shipping.
Hello {contact}, we confirm order {order_id} for {customer}, total {total}. Payment terms are {terms_days} days.
Hello {contact}, the pallet for order {order_id} ships with {carrier}. Please confirm that someone can receive it and tell us your delivery window.
Hello {contact}, the invoice for order {order_id} is {total}, due on {due_date}. Thank you for your order.
Hello {contact}, please tell us your delivery window for order {order_id} and any rules for the loading bay.
Hello {contact}, one item of order {order_id} is out of stock. We can send a similar product or ship the rest now. Which do you prefer?
Hello {person}, please open the Order Pipeline today: urgent and wholesale orders first. Thank you.
Hello {person}, please pick and pack the open batch before the first carrier pickup. Tell me if you need help.
Packer: fragile item, pack with care
Hello {packed_by}, order {order_id} has a fragile item ({handling}). Pack it with filler and a corrugated insert.
Hello {person}, the same-day cut-off moved today. Please tell the packers and check the Dispatch Board.
Hello {owner}, order {order_id} for {customer} has waited {age_days} days at stage {status}. Please move it today.
Hello {person}, your roster for the week of {week} has {hours} hours. Please confirm or tell me what to change.
Hello, {item} is down to {on_hand} units with {days_left} days left. Please order {order_qty} units.
Hello, case {lt_id}: order {order_id} is {issue} with {carrier}. Net cost {net_cost}. Please review the carrier.
Hello, order {order_id} on {channel} cost {ship_cost} to ship and the customer paid {charged}. The gap is {gap}.
Hello, {carrier} zone {zone}: {orders} orders, {late_orders} late, real transit {avg_transit} days against {days} promised.
Carrier: parcel is overdue, trace it
Hello, please trace the parcel of order {order_id}. It is {issue}. Please tell us where it is today.
Hello, the parcel of order {order_id} arrived damaged. We send photos and claim {compensation}. Please confirm.
Hello, please collect {parcels} parcel(s) for order {order_id} at {pickup_hour}:00 today.
Carrier: rate review for a zone
Hello, please send your updated rates for zone {zone}. Our cost for 5 kg is now {cost_5kg}.
Hello, order {order_id} on {channel} is {over_days} days over the promise with {carrier}. Please contact the customer.
Hello, {date}: {orders} orders, {units} units, sales {revenue}, {same_day} shipped the same day, {cancelled} cancelled.
Hello, for {name} (week of {week}) we expect {expected_orders} orders and need {packers_needed} packers; short by {gap}. May I add staff?
Your order has {col:orders.items} items. Subtotal {col:orders.subtotal}, discount {col:orders.discount}, shipping {col:orders.ship_charged}, sales tax {col:orders.tax}. Total: {col:orders.total}.
We send it with {col:orders.carrier} to {col:orders.region}. The carrier needs about {col:orders.promised} days after we ship it.
Thank you for your order. Reply to this message if anything needs to change.
Pick list for an open order
The order is at stage {col:pipeline.status} and is {col:pipeline.age_days} days old. Next action: {col:pipeline.next_action}. Owner: {col:pipeline.owner}.
Pick the products in shelf order, check each code against the order lines and pack with the filler that the handling asks for.
Sign when the order is packed and labelled.
